title: Node graph runtime cleanup: one RunReport per run with a revision counter, the node tree as the only view of a run, one node registry, compiled-group outputSources
description:
Repo plan phase 3, merges 3B.8-10 (subsumes the DSL-47 cleanup offered on 2026-10-17). Problems:
- Two views of a run: NodeGraphRuntime.statements (~89) beside the tree root (~104); executeResource reads statements' last id (~271); executeGraphResult's fallback walks parsedStatements probing port names (~546-560); staticPaths() is a third index (~653); RingTool scans graph.statements and re-parses source (RingTool.java ~595, 2171, 2245, 2340, 2493).
- Timing in five formats: lastTimingMs, lastPeakHeapBytes, logTimings, treeLines/treeRecords (~151-187, 354-384); MeshNodeViewerScene.logTiming with a 1 ms threshold vs SLOW_NODE_MS=100; the Timing and NodeInspect endpoints. 'Total' is inconsistent: executeGraphResult resets then adds (~520-529), pull() only adds (~761, 780), so successive pulls sum. No run revision counter.
- A compiled group's evaluate-computed output (QuadLayoutNode LAYOUT, QuadLayoutNode.java:208-218) has no outputSources (~980-990), so DslGraphLayout (:232) draws no edge for it.
- Node lookup in six places: the generated MAP, its Desktop twin (~337-340), REGISTRY_CLASSES/DESKTOP_SUPPLIERS/REGISTRY_IDS_BY_CLASS (~52-56, 392, 414), per-instance registerNode (~316), hard-coded INPUT_NODE_TYPES (~50), direct MAP reads in MeshNodeCatalog and LiteralParameterDescriptor. Also the four 16-line generated-map wrappers (CanvasSceneMap, GeometryMap, CommandMap, AutomationRouteMap).
- ModelChoice.readSource, NodeGraphRuntime.readSource/fromResource and DungeonViewerScene each resolve DSL resources: one resolver.
Target: one per-run report (revision, total, per-node records) produced by both executeGraphResult and pull; the tree is the only run view and RingTool reads the program through an API, not statements; group outputs record their sources; node lookup has one owner (an existing class, not a new one, where possible).

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. statements, staticPaths, lastTimingMs and the duplicate timing formatters are gone; one per-run report with a revision counter feeds the log, the Timing/NodeInspect endpoints and the graph view.
2. pull and full runs report totals the same way (test).
3. The graph view draws QuadLayoutNode's LAYOUT edge.
4. One node lookup; INPUT_NODE_TYPES derived, not hard-coded.
5. Timing endpoint JSON stays compatible with ixdar-cli (or the CLI is updated in the same change).
6. Unit suite, ring fingerprints byte-identical; launch entry and screenshot of the graph view.

7. (Agreed 2026-10-18) DoD 3 evidence: no graph or node reads layout.layout (QuadLayoutScene pulls it from code), so the LAYOUT edge cannot appear live. Instead an output a compiled group computes in evaluate records outputSources as the list of the wired outputs' sources, DslGraphLayout fans one input out to several edges through it (DslGraphLayoutTest.anOutputACompiledGroupComputesDrawsAnEdgeFromEveryWiredOutputItRead), and node-inspect layout shows output_sources.layout. The per-run report's log line NodeGraphRuntime.logTimings (total, peak heap, revision, nodes >= SLOW_NODE_MS) stays: it is the log DoD 1 names.

Keeps Platforms.log in NodeGraphRuntime.logTimings: it is the per-run report's log line (total, peak, revision, nodes >= SLOW_NODE_MS) that DoD 1 requires, replacing the earlier logTimings line and MeshNodeViewerScene.logTiming.

The log line is the 'graph run report' NodeGraphRuntime.logTimings prints.

Log identifier as wt done reads it: graph run report
testing-plan:
1. mvn test plus new tests for revision and totals.
2. ixdar-cli timing and node-inspect on the quad-layout scene.
3. Live: ctrl+G on the quad-layout scene.
todos: DONE : Follow-up (left out of DSL-50 by agreement): one DSL resource resolver — ModelChoice.readSource and NodeGraphRuntime.fromResource/readText each resolve DSL resources.
changes-made: 2026-10-18 runtime cleanup. NodeGraphRuntime: statements, staticPaths, lastTimingMs/lastTotalMs/lastPeakHeapBytes, registerNode/registerAllFromAnnotationRegistry/annotationRegistryClasses, REGISTRY_CLASSES/DESKTOP_SUPPLIERS/desktopRegistryMap and the per-runtime node registry are gone. No new class: the per-run report is the tree root (root.body = program, root.children = records, root.elapsedNanos = total, root.peakHeapBytes = peak) plus a runtime 'revision' counter (bumped by reset and by every outermost full run or pull); one clock at the outermost evaluation entry, so full runs and pulls time the run the same way and nested entries are not double counted. One text formatter treeLines(minMs) (total/peak/revision line + tree) feeds logTimings and node-inspect; Timing JSON reads the root (adds 'revision', otherwise unchanged); DslGraphView redraws on revision; MeshNodeViewerScene's duplicate 1 ms logTiming deleted. statementAt(path) walks the program for override validation, pull and node-inspect errors (nearest paths). executeGraphResult's fallback walks root.children. One node lookup: REGISTERED_NODES (generated + desktop via Class.forName), INPUT_NODE_TYPES derived (registered nodes with a 'default' input); MeshNodeCatalog, LiteralParameterDescriptor, GraphValidator/GraphAnalyzer, ValidateDsl, BatchDslEvaluator (NUMERIC_INPUT_NODE_TYPES derived), SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer use it. RingTool/RingDslWriter read the run through root.children/root.body and reparse edited text with new PythonParser.parse(source). Compiled-group computed outputs (QuadLayoutNode LAYOUT) record outputSources = list of wired outputs' sources; DslGraphLayout fans one input out to several edges; node-inspect shows output_sources. GeometryMap, CommandMap, AutomationRouteMap deleted (callers read the generated MAPs); CanvasSceneMap kept (adds ixdar-canvas). Verified: mvn test 527/527 (new NodeGraphTreeTest.fullRunsAndPullsReportTheRunTotalTheSameWayAndMoveTheRevision, DslGraphLayoutTest.anOutputACompiledGroupComputesDrawsAnEdgeFromEveryWiredOutputItRead); test_cli 94/96, the 2 scaffold failures fail identically on procgen-13. Regression vs procgen-13 baseline: crawfish/fertility ring fixture copies mesh sha, every ring fingerprint and region list identical; dungeon_2d/3d fingerprints identical; quad-suite bolt/fertility/block/fandisk/rockerarm/hand signatures and screenshots MATCH. timing/node-inspect JSON: only additive keys (revision, output_sources). Screenshot tmp/dsl-50-graph-view.png; launch 'DSL-50: quad-layout'.
